{{color box|#9400D3|border=darkgray}} [[Padajon Surigao|PS]] |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank2_info = Majority }} '''Surigao del Norte's 1st congressional district''' is one of the two [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Surigao del Norte]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 1987.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 22, 2021}} The district encompasses the island chains off the northeast coast of mainland Surigao del Norte. Since the 2007 redistricting following the separation of [[Dinagat Islands]], the district now comprises the [[Siargao]] and [[Bucas Grande]] municipalities of [[Burgos, Surigao del Norte|Burgos]], [[Dapa, Surigao del Norte|Dapa]], [[Del Carmen, Surigao del Norte|Del Carmen]], [[General Luna, Surigao del Norte|General Luna]], [[Pilar, Surigao del Norte|Pilar]], [[San Benito, Surigao del Norte|San Benito]], [[San Isidro, Surigao del Norte|San Isidro]], [[Santa Monica, Surigao del Norte|Santa Monica]] and [[Socorro, Surigao del Norte|Socorro]].{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=February 22, 2021}} It also included [[Dinagat Islands]] until it was established as a distinct province in 2006.{{cite web|url=http://www.senate.gov.ph/republic_acts/ra%25209355.pdf |title=Republic Act No. 9355 |publisher=[[Senate of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 22, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Francisco Matugas]] of the [[Lakas–CMD]] and [[Padajon Surigao]].{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 22, 2021}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
